title: Dog Day Care
excerpt: Supervised days of play, enrichment and rest at our 5★ licensed daycare centre, with collection and drop-off in our own dog vans.
intro: A qualified team of dog lovers, on hand to give your dog 5★ care. Our licensed daycare centre has a secure private paddock, two large heated indoor playrooms and plenty to explore, and our team know dog behaviour and body language inside out. Your dog gets a balanced day of exercise, mental stimulation and downtime, then comes home happy and tired.
highlights: 5★ licensed daycare centre with secure indoor and outdoor play areas
Exclusive use of a secure private paddock and two large heated indoor playrooms
Paddling pools, sniffing and enrichment areas, interactive toys and agility equipment
Fully supervised all day. Dogs are never left unattended
Balanced mix of exercise, mental stimulation and downtime
Several of the team are qualified dog trainers who tailor care to each dog
Pick-up and drop-off in professionally fitted, secure dog vans
Each team member covers a dedicated collection area, so less time on the road
pricingNote: Every dog starts with a trial session with one of our training and behaviour team, so they can sniff things out and make new friends. Get in touch for current prices and availability.
notes: All dogs must be sociable and comfortable around other dogs.
We are unable to accept adult entire males or females in season.
Puppies are welcome from 10 weeks old, or once their vaccinations are complete. If your pup still has three meals a day, please send a lunchbox.
